purpose: Held-out functional assessment, not a keyword test or model ranking
C1-source-support: Rejects universal/independent-study wording with specific reasons
Keeps source identity, revision, actual inspected extent and exact supporting locator
Records a concrete unresolved gap and resolution action for inaccessible theorem
Offers a narrower source-reported statement and does not fabricate access
C2-review-conflict: Independently verifies the valid variance derivation and refutes the negative-X objection
Maps the known result's conditions and contribution impact without treating reuse as novelty
Adjudicates each finding with evidence and separates the fix from its verification
Specifies changed-artifact/dependency recheck and records unexecuted independent model review honestly
C3-parity: Rejects correctness inference from headline parity
Identifies sample-count, ordering and warning-channel mismatches
Defines justified tolerances before further comparisons without retrospective widening
Checks comparator rejection on missing, empty, misaligned and deliberately wrong outputs
Provides a smallest witness and separates implementation fidelity from scientific validity
C4-resume-and-write: Does not assert benefit or mechanism beyond the recorded uncertainty
Invalidates the old review after material metric change and names affected outputs
Does not duplicate unknown job9 or spend unreserved remaining budget
Preserves round, revisions, approvals, actual coverage, gap next action and resume prerequisite
Produces useful draft text that labels unrecomputed results
